## Codex security hold

The bundled [static scaffold fixture](scripts/cursor_plugin_scaffold_fixture.py) requires an explicit marked disposable destination and writes only Cursor-format manifest, README, caller-supplied LICENSE, and static component placeholders. Synthetic tests run the held submission auditor on that output. The source below still defaults to `~/.cursor/plugins/local/` and describes immediate Cursor availability; do not follow that default or treat this candidate as a native Codex plugin installer. Hooks, mcpServers, and marketplace wiring return `REVIEW_REQUIRED` before any write. The source `mcp-plugin-hook-install` finding is retained and the skill remains unindexed.
